A spontaneous evening shot, a candid moment caught in motion. Taken on an iPhone 17 Pro with flash. The frame should look like a real photo from a personal gallery, not a staged fashion shoot.

POSE: The girl is sitting directly on wide, light-colored stone steps, with her torso slightly turned into a 3/4 angle. One leg is bent closer to her body, while the other rests on the step below.

At the moment of capture, the girl raises both hands to quickly tie her hair into a high, messy ponytail. Her elbows are positioned on opposite sides of her head, with her hands still in motion. Her head is slightly turned to the side, and her gaze is directed past the camera. Her lips are relaxed and slightly parted.

The frame is captured in the exact in-between second — her hair is not fully tied yet, part of it is still held in her hands, and several strands are flying freely near her face. Subtle directional motion blur on the hands, hair ends, and edges of the clothing. Do not blur or deform the facial features; the face must remain clear, recognizable, and true to the original.

HAIR: Very long, thick hair. Most of the hair is being lifted upward and backward by her hands, while the lower section still falls freely over her shoulders and back. A few thin strands have come loose around the temples and cheeks. Do not let them cover the eyes, nose, or lips.

MAKEUP: Expressive modern evening makeup. A thin, elongated black winged eyeliner, voluminous lashes with a fox-eye effect, laminated brows. The lips are outlined with a cool brownish-pink pencil slightly darker than the natural lip tone, with a translucent berry-nude gloss inside. Skin is slightly tanned, fresh, with visible real pores and natural micro-texture.

CLOTHING: A fitted white top with a wide boat neckline, revealing the collarbones and one shoulder. Long sleeves partially cover the hands. Bottoms: loose black low-rise trousers with soft folds.

ACCESSORIES: Large silver hoop earrings, one chunky silver ring. Manicure: short square nails, in a shade matching the top.

ENVIRONMENT: A wide outdoor stone staircase at night. Light-colored natural stone occupies almost the entire background and creates graphic horizontal lines. No restaurants, cars, signs, flowers, or decorative objects. The upper part of the frame gradually falls into darkness.

FLASH PHOTOGRAPHY: Deep night. The only main light source is the direct built-in iPhone flash. It sharply illuminates the face, collarbones, raised hands, top, and nearest steps.

The light falls off quickly into the depth of the staircase. Distant steps fade into gray-black shadow. No soft studio lighting and no evenly illuminated scene.

CAMERA: iPhone 17 Pro, vertical 9:16 format. Medium-close framing, approximately from mid-thighs to the space slightly above the raised hands. The camera is close, positioned slightly above and to the side, as if someone standing nearby suddenly raised their phone and pressed the shutter while the girl was tying her hair.

The girl is not perfectly centered. One elbow is close to the upper edge of the frame, and part of the jacket is naturally cropped at the bottom. Handheld, slightly imperfect framing.

Natural skin, realistic texture of hair, knit fabric, trousers, and stone. Slight digital noise, visible fine film grain, muted nighttime color rendering, deep shadows, subtle vignette, RAW unedited feeling.

Do not use 8K, ultra sharp, HDR, beauty filters, airbrushing, plastic skin, artificial bokeh, studio lighting, perfect symmetry, or a glossy AI look.

一个随性的夜晚抓拍，定格瞬间的动感画面。使用 iPhone 17 Pro 拍摄，开启闪光灯。画面应该像个人相册里的一张真实照片，而不是摆拍式的时尚大片。

姿势：女孩直接坐在宽大、浅色的石阶上，身体微微转向 3/4 角度。一条腿向身体内侧弯曲，另一条腿搁在下一级台阶上。

按下快门的瞬间，女孩正抬起双手快速将头发扎成一个高高的凌乱马尾。她的双肘分别位于头部两侧，手仍处于动态之中。她的头微微侧向一边，目光越过镜头望向别处。嘴唇放松且微微张开。

画面定格在那个介于动作之间的精确瞬间——她的头发还没有完全扎好，一部分仍握在手中，几缕发丝在脸颊附近自由飞舞。手部、发梢和衣物边缘带有微妙的定向运动模糊。不要模糊或扭曲面部特征；面部必须保持清晰、可辨，并忠于原貌。

发型：非常长且浓密的头发。大部分头发被双手向上向后提起，下半部分仍然自由垂落在肩膀和背部。太阳穴和脸颊周围有几缕松散下来的细发。不要让这些发丝盖住眼睛、鼻子或嘴唇。

妆容：富有表现力的现代晚间妆容。细长上扬的黑色眼尾眼线、呈现狐狸眼效应的浓密睫毛、定型眉毛。唇部用一支偏冷的棕粉色唇线笔描边，比自然唇色略深，内部涂抹一层半透明的莓果裸色唇釉。肤色略带古铜色、清新自然，保留可见的真实毛孔和自然微纹理。

服装：修身的白色上衣，配宽船形领口，露出锁骨和一侧肩膀。长袖部分覆盖双手。下装：宽松的黑色低腰长裤，带柔和的褶皱。

配饰：大号银色圈形耳环，一枚粗犷的银色戒指。美甲：短方形指甲，颜色与上衣相配。

环境：夜晚户外的宽大石阶。浅色天然石材占据几乎整个背景，并形成富有图形感的水平线条。画面中不要出现餐厅、汽车、招牌、花卉或装饰物。画面上半部分逐渐没入黑暗之中。

闪光摄影：深夜。唯一的主要光源是 iPhone 内置的直接闪光。它锐利地照亮面部、锁骨、抬起的双手、上衣和最近的台阶。

光线在向楼梯深处延伸时迅速衰减。远处的台阶消融为灰黑色的阴影。不要使用柔和的影棚灯光，也不要让场景被均匀照亮。

相机：iPhone 17 Pro，竖版 9:16 画幅。中近景构图，范围大约从大腿中部到抬起的双手上方一点的空间。镜头贴近主体，位置略微偏上且偏向一侧，仿佛是旁边有人突然举起手机、在女孩扎头发的瞬间按下快门。

Seedance 2.5 提示词
制作一段15秒的电影级真人喜剧短片，场景设定在…

Seedance 2.5 Prompt
Create a 15-second cinematic live-action comedy video set at Shibuya Scramble Crossing, Tokyo.

CHARACTER REFERENCE
Use the attached image as the strict reference for the protagonist’s face, hairstyle, clothing, and overall appearance. She has black twin tails with black ribbons, a black Gothic Lolita dress with layered lace and ruffles, a black lace choker, and black platform boots.
Preserve her identity and outfit throughout every shot.
The reference sheet contains multiple views of ONE woman. Show exactly ONE protagonist. Do not reproduce the character sheet.
LOCATION AND STYLE
Shibuya Scramble Crossing, with recognizable diagonal white zebra crossings, surrounding buildings, and large LED screens.
Blue-hour lighting, realistic architecture, cinematic contrast, detailed fabric, and photorealistic blockbuster VFX.
The intersection is temporarily empty, with no pedestrians or moving vehicles.
Keep the same location, lighting, and character across all cuts.
STORY
A seemingly powerful witch attempts an intimidating attack, but produces only a tiny spark. Her accidental sneeze then unleashes a devastating shockwave. She realizes another sneeze is coming and desperately suppresses it.
SHOT 1 — 0.0–2.5 seconds
Low-angle wide shot of the woman standing in the center of Shibuya Scramble Crossing.
An enormous violet magic circle already glows beneath her boots. Dark energy curls around her, and small pieces of debris hover nearby.
Her twin tails and dress ruffles flutter in the magical wind.

WITH subject_analysis AS (
  SELECT
    '$SUBJECT' AS subject,
    infer_iconic_silhouette('$SUBJECT') AS hero_form,
    infer_supporting_forms('$SUBJECT', 2, 4) AS secondary_forms,
    infer_landmark_silhouettes('$SUBJECT') AS background_landmarks,
    infer_foreground_objects('$SUBJECT') AS low_props,
    infer_symbolic_circle_anchor('$SUBJECT') AS halo_anchor
),
palette AS (
  SELECT
    'cool family: desaturated blue/teal/slate' AS cool_zone,
    'warm family: muted amber/ochre/cream' AS warm_zone,
    'restrained neutrals: ivory, graphite, paper white' AS neutrals,
    'two-zone split — cool upper / warm lower, or mirrored' AS zone_logic
  FROM subject_analysis
),
composition AS (
  SELECT
    halo_anchor,
    hero_form, secondary_forms, background_landmarks, low_props,
    'poster with strong central/near-central graphic anchors' AS structure,
    'large circular forms, clean silhouette blocking, controlled negative space' AS shape_language,
    'shallow-to-moderate theatrical stage depth' AS depth,
    'foreground devices arranged in a low horizontal spread to widen the scene' AS prop_logic,
    'sparse background with silhouette landmarks and atmospheric emptiness' AS background,
    'contemplative sci-fi with conceptual poster appeal' AS mood
  FROM subject_analysis
)
SELECT
  render_halo_poster(
    subject := subject,
    hero := hero_form,
    secondary := secondary_forms,
    halo := halo_anchor,
    background := background_landmarks,
    props := low_props,
    palette := cool_zone || ' + ' || warm_zone || ' + ' || neutrals || '; ' || zone_logic,
    structure := structure,
    shape_language := shape_language,
    depth := depth,
    prop_logic := prop_logic,
    background_rule := background,
    illustration := 'smooth digital drawing, reduced texture, clear outlines, elegant shape simplification',
    finish := 'refined graphic concept-poster, quiet premium illustration, strong icon-like readability from a distance',
    mood := mood,
    negative := 'cluttered scenic realism, over-rendered background detail, chaotic color variety, gritty texture overlays, exaggerated fisheye or extreme cinematic distortion'
  ) AS final_image
FROM composition, palette;
RETURN final_image;

手工切割的分层纸艺作品，描绘静水之上宁静的落日。黑色纸张剪影由厚实带纹理的卡纸切割而成，分层叠放在闪烁的虹彩箔纸之上，虹彩箔纸从每一个镂空窗格透出微光。

天空：以青绿色、深绿松石色和深青色构成的渐变在地平线处融入温暖的古金色与琥珀色落日余晖；箔纸表面皱褶开裂，像被锤击的金属一般，破碎的光线在其上闪烁。细长的水平黑色纸纹作为风格化的云朵横切天空。

地平线：一条实心的黑色剪影线，勾勒出低矮的远山与圆润的树木；画面中央偏上方停着一艘小巧简约的划艇，带一根细长的桅杆，刚刚位于水线之上。

中景：左侧是一排九到十根粗细不均的黑色木制栈桥桩，矗立在水中；两岸散布着黑色的香蒲与细长的草叶。船下水面上有一条金色倒光的窄长反光带。

前景：水面的表现处理为一层层堆叠的水平纸带，每一条由细窄的黑色纸带与发光的虹彩绿松石与金色纸带交替排列，以柔和的透视向画面底缘层叠而下。

质感：可见的剪纸边缘、每层纸面下方因真实物理厚度形成的细微投影、细腻的纸纹肌理、哑光黑与光泽虹彩箔纸的对照。整洁、平面化、装饰性强、宁静、无任何文字。

A tall teal energy wave tears farther down the road. A wide shot shows a deeper trench and another burst of rubble. Keep the energy's path visible before impact; retain all earlier damage.
A finishes planted, sword controlled. The score reaches its final accent.

Cut to A, looking satisfied as dust drifts behind her. Stop the music.

<One clearly audible mosquito buzz; faint settling rubble>
No dialogue, gasp or vocal breath.

Medium-wide shot. B walks in from screen-right and stops beside A, holding her own drawn katana.
A remains screen-left, B screen-right. Both stand on intact ground at the center of the damaged crossing.

Create a premium 3:4 vertical vintage travel poster for [COUNTRY / CITY / LOCATION / SUBJECT].

TEXT-TO-IMAGE ONLY — create the entire artwork from the destination alone. No reference image required.

CORE CONCEPT
Reimagine [COUNTRY / CITY / LOCATION / SUBJECT] as a cohesive collectible vintage travel poster, using hand-painted gouache and watercolor with a sophisticated mid-century tourism aesthetic.

COMPOSITION
Use a warm cream paper background with generous negative space. Place a huge hand-painted destination name across the top in bold, imperfect deep-red uppercase lettering.

Behind the main scene, add a large glowing golden-yellow sun or atmospheric disc. Build the destination in clear overlapping layers — foreground, water/road/landscape, primary landmark, secondary architecture and nature, distant skyline or mountains, then sky.

Automatically choose 4–6 of the destination’s most recognizable visual elements. Make ONE iconic landmark the dominant focal point and use the others to support the story. Add a characteristic local transportation element when naturally appropriate.

VISUAL STYLE
Hand-painted gouache × watercolor travel illustration × vintage postcard × elegant editorial poster.

Use visible brushstrokes, subtle paper grain, imperfect painted edges, layered washes, simplified graphic forms, crisp silhouettes, selective fine details, and slightly exaggerated but believable proportions.

No photorealism.

COLOR
Use warm cream as the base with a destination-specific palette built around deep red, golden ochre, teal/turquoise, sky blue, leafy green, terracotta, and warm architectural neutrals. Keep the colors rich, harmonious, and distinctly vintage.

ATMOSPHERE
Bright, optimistic, nostalgic, and aspirational. Add only a few purposeful clouds, birds, foliage, people, or atmospheric details to give the scene life without creating clutter.

FOREGROUND
Create a strong local foreground element — such as a street, boat, train, tram, cable car, road, waterfront, vegetation, or characteristic landscape — with painterly shadows, reflections, and tiny human details.

FINAL AESTHETIC
A unified hand-painted travel illustration that feels like a premium vintage tourism poster from a collectible series. Strong hierarchy, layered depth, recognizable silhouettes, balanced asymmetry, elegant typography, and a clear sense of place.

Avoid generic tourist imagery, unrelated landmarks, collage-like composition, excessive tiny details, 3D rendering, glossy CGI, photorealism, modern digital effects, logos, watermarks, and clutter.

FORMAT
3:4 vertical, single cohesive illustration, premium print quality, sophisticated vintage travel-poster finish.

核心概念
将 [国家 / 城市 / 地点 / 主题] 重塑为一幅统一且具收藏价值的复古旅行海报，采用手绘水粉与水彩技法，呈现精致的世纪中叶旅游美学。

自动选取目的地的 4–6 个最具辨识度的视觉元素。将一处标志性建筑作为主导焦点，其余元素用以辅助叙事。在自然合适的情况下，加入一处具有当地特色的交通工具元素。

手绘水粉 × 水彩旅行插画 × 复古明信片 × 优雅的编辑海报。

运用可见的笔触、细微的纸张肌理、略有瑕疵的笔触边缘、分层的水彩晕染、简化的图形语言、清晰的剪影、选择性的精致细节，以及略加夸张但仍可信的比例。

不使用照片级真实感。

色彩
以温暖的奶油色为底，搭配以深红、金赭石、青绿/松石绿、天蓝、叶绿、赤陶色及温暖的建筑中性色构成的、目的地专属的色调。色彩应浓郁、和谐，并具有鲜明的复古感。

氛围
明亮、乐观、怀旧而令人向往。仅添加少量有目的性的云朵、飞鸟、植被、人物或氛围细节，使场景生动而不杂乱。

前景
打造一个强烈的当地前景元素 —— 如街道、船只、火车、电车、缆车、道路、水滨、植被或具有代表性的景观 —— 带有绘画感的阴影、倒影与微小的人物细节。

最终美学
一幅统一的手绘旅行插画，呈现出收藏系列中高端复古旅游海报的质感。具备清晰的层级感、分层的纵深、可辨识的剪影、平衡的不对称性、优雅的排版，以及清晰的地方感。

避免使用：泛化的游客形象、不相关的地标、拼贴式的构图、过多的微小细节、3D 渲染、光泽感的 CGI、照片级真实感、现代数字特效、标志、水印以及杂乱的内容。

The transformation has a clear origin, so the bike reads as performance created by the formula—not a separate visual metaphor.

This preserves the eye path and makes the oil feel heavy, viscous, and controlled instead of explosively random.

Create a Cannes-level commercial poster for fictional premium motorcycle engine-oil brand KANEDA TORQ, merging tactile product realism, workshop atmosphere, and liquid-born machine symbolism into one unified hero image. The core concept is engineered ignition: a single central engine-oil bottle stands on the floor of a dark performance garage, and a stream of molten golden lubricant rises from its neck to become a glowing high-performance motorcycle suspended above it, as if protection and power are materializing into speed. The bottle remains the absolute visual leader.

Use a vertical full-bleed poster with a front-facing hero layout, strong central symmetry, and disciplined rule-of-thirds balance. Preserve the exact structure: one dominant oil bottle in the lower center, a vertical fluid-energy column rising from the neck, and a luminous custom motorcycle formed in the upper-middle of the frame. Use a premium workshop background with believable but softened mechanical depth on both sides, preserving strong negative space around the central transformation and upper headline zone. The bottle anchors the composition while the glowing bike acts as the upward emotional release.

Design a premium 4-stroke synthetic motorcycle engine-oil bottle in rich amber-gold molded polymer, with precise ergonomic geometry, subtle grip texture, crisp cap design, and a refined label system in ivory, deep charcoal, and restrained red accents. The fictional brand is “KANEDA TORQ” and the product identity is “4T RACING SYNTHETIC”. The bottle must feel manufacturable, shelf-credible, and highly desirable, with realistic plastic sheen, embossed detail, and exact label clarity. The cap stays intact, but the bottle neck emits energy as if the formula itself is converting into motion.

From the bottle neck, a thick luminous stream of golden oil and light rises with believable viscosity and controlled turbulence, then gradually resolves into a custom roadster motorcycle with realistic frame logic, front forks, tank, engine block, seat line, wheel structure, and performance stance. The motorcycle must feel made from fluid energy and molten lubrication rather than solid metal, yet keep mechanically accurate proportions. It hovers slightly angled upward, front wheel higher than the rear, with elegant liquid trails, small sparks, and fine droplets guiding the eye from bottle to bike. The transformation must feel aerodynamic, premium, and physically persuasive, never cartoon-fantasy.

Set the scene in a high-end motorcycle tuning workshop at night, dark, moody, and industrial. Keep background mechanics secondary and softened: hanging tools, workbenches, tire forms, polished engine components, and one partially visible engine assembly at the edges for scale and authenticity. The floor should feel dark, worn, slightly reflective, and lightly scattered with realistic workshop tools and parts, enough to ground the scene without clutter. Depth comes from foreground tools, the sharply rendered bottle, the glowing liquid-bike transformation, and deeper workshop layers behind.

Lighting and color merge into one controlled palette: 60% oil-black, deep charcoal, and workshop blue-grey shadow; 30% molten gold, amber-orange liquid light, and warm metallic reflections; 10% ivory label contrast and restrained red performance accents. Main illumination comes from the bottle and the luminous fluid-bike transformation, reinforced by narrow rim lights outlining surrounding machinery. Warm reflected glow should kiss the bottle shoulders, floor, and adjacent mechanical parts. Avoid muddy blacks, cheap neon colors, exaggerated fire effects, and overbuilt VFX. The tone is aggressive, engineered, premium, and mechanically seductive.

Materials must feel extremely real: polymer grain, fine mold seams, label adhesion, edge highlights, and controlled specular rolloff on the bottle; a dense glossy oil stream with convincing surface tension as it resolves into the motorcycle form; workshop-grade steel, restrained oil-dark reflections, and subtle wear on tools and engine parts; and a tactile, slightly oily floor that stays real without becoming dirty or chaotic. The image should read as a flagship international ad visual: sharp, polished, and technically irresistible.

All in-image text must be English only and integrated into the poster architecture. In the upper left, place a bold layered headline: “POWER IN MOTION”, with one word emphasized in a more expressive performance-style display while the rest remains in a refined condensed sans-serif. In the upper right, place a compact KANEDA TORQ brand lockup with a small technical line such as “advanced race formulation”. Keep the packaging text on the bottle as part of the label only. If a discreet support line is used near the lower area, use something like “engineered to protect every hard mile.” Typography must feel premium, fast, and fused with the workshop glow.

Output: a full-bleed premium engine-oil poster with product-first hierarchy, one central hero bottle, a golden motorcycle formed from liquid rising from the bottle, a realistic workshop environment, English text only, no human figures, no extra hero bottles, no warped motorcycle anatomy, no broken wheel geometry, no unreadable label, no clutter overload, no muddy shadows, no dead black blocks, no low-quality AI texture, no cheap sci-fi fire, no generic flyer styling, and no style drift.

设计一款高级的 4 冲程合成摩托车机油瓶，材质为饱和的琥珀金色模塑聚合物，具备精准的人体工学造型、细微的握持纹理、清晰的瓶盖，以及由象牙白、深炭灰与克制红色点缀构成的精致标签体系。虚构品牌为 “KANEDA TORQ”，产品身份为 “4T RACING SYNTHETIC”。瓶子必须具有可量产感、上架可信度与高度吸引力，呈现真实的塑料光泽、压花细节与清晰的标签。瓶盖保持完整，但瓶口散发出能量，仿佛配方本身正在转化为动力。

从瓶口升起一股浓稠而发光的金色油液与光之流，具有真实的黏度与可控的湍流，随后逐渐凝聚为一辆定制 roadster 摩托车，拥有真实的车架逻辑、前叉、油箱、发动机、座垫线、车轮结构与性能姿态。摩托车必须让人觉得是由流体能量与熔融润滑油构成，而非固态金属，但仍保持机械上的精确比例。它略微向上倾斜悬停，前轮高于后轮，带有优雅的液体拖尾、微小火星与精细液滴，引导视线从瓶子流向摩托车。转化过程必须具有空气动力学感、高级感与物理说服力，绝不能是卡通化的奇幻感。

场景设定在夜晚一家高端摩托车改装车间，黑暗、阴郁且工业化。背景机械保持次要且柔化处理：悬挂的工具、工作台、轮胎造型、抛光的发动机零部件，以及在画面边缘若隐若现的一套发动机总成，用于提供尺度感与真实感。地面应显得深色、有磨损感、轻微反光，并零散地摆放真实的维修工具与零件，足以稳定画面而不显杂乱。纵深感来自前景工具、清晰渲染的瓶子、发光的液体—摩托车转化，以及后方更深的车间层次。

灯光与色彩融合为一个受控的调色体系：60% 为机油黑、深炭灰与车间的蓝灰色阴影；30% 为熔金、琥珀橙色液体光与温暖的金属反射；10% 为象牙白标签对比色与克制的红色性能点缀。主光来自瓶子与发光的液体—摩托车转化，并由勾勒周围机件的窄幅轮廓光加以强化。温暖的反光应轻抚瓶肩、地面与相邻的机械部件。避免浑浊的黑、廉价的霓虹色、夸张的火焰效果以及过度的特效。整体调性应具有攻击性、工程感、高级感与机械的诱惑力。

材质必须极度真实：聚合物颗粒感、细微的模具接缝、标签贴合感、边缘高光，以及瓶身上受控的高光衰减；浓密有光泽的油流在凝聚为摩托车形态时具有可信的表面张力；车间级钢材、受控的机油暗反射，以及工具与发动机部件上的细微磨损；以及一种触感真实、略带油污的地面，保持真实而不肮脏杂乱。图像应读起来像旗舰级的国际广告主视觉：锐利、精良，技术上无可抗拒。

画面内所有文字必须仅为英文，并融入海报的版面架构中。左上方放置一条加粗的分层标题：“POWER IN MOTION”，其中一个单词以更具表现力的运动风格展示字体加以强调，其余文字则使用精致的窄体无衬线字体。右上方放置一个紧凑的 KANEDA TORQ 品牌锁定组合，并配一行小的技术性文字，例如 “advanced race formulation”。瓶身上的包装文字仅作为标签的一部分。如需在下方区域使用一行低调的辅助文案，可使用类似 “engineered to protect every hard mile.” 的语句。字体风格必须显得高级、快速，并与车间光感相融合。

CORE CONCEPT

Blend a photorealistic historic cityscape with a futuristic long-exposure transformation. The real architecture remains sharply recognizable while selected buildings stretch vertically into elegant trails of white, cream, gold, and warm amber light, creating a surreal double-exposure effect.

COMPOSITION

Build one seamless vertical cityscape around the strongest visual identity of [COUNTRY / CITY / LOCATION / SUBJECT].

Use cinematic haze, realistic atmospheric depth, sharp architectural textures, detailed foliage, glowing windows, and subtle motion blur.

COLOR

Contrast a muted blue-gray sky with warm golden, amber, orange, or copper highlights inspired by the destination. Keep the palette sophisticated and cinematic rather than neon or overly saturated.

STYLE

Photorealistic architectural photography × surreal double exposure × futuristic long-exposure photography × vertical light streaks × cinematic travel artwork.

FINAL AESTHETIC

Dreamlike, atmospheric, sophisticated, cinematic, highly detailed, and unmistakably connected to [COUNTRY / CITY / LOCATION / SUBJECT].

4:5 vertical, single seamless composition, photorealistic detail, dramatic depth, controlled vertical motion blur, cinematic lighting, premium conceptual travel-art finish.

将一张照片级真实感的历史城市景观与未来感的超长曝光变形相融合。真实建筑保持清晰可辨，而被选中的建筑向上延伸为白色、米色、金色与温暖琥珀色的优雅光痕，营造出超现实的双重曝光效果。

构图

围绕 [COUNTRY / CITY / LOCATION / SUBJECT] 最强的视觉特征，搭建一幅无缝的竖版城市景观。

在上方放置一个戏剧性的发光太阳或大气光源，背景为冷调蓝灰色天空。其下方组合真实的历史建筑、街道、桥梁、自然环境，并在合适的位置加入恰当的水岸或可反射的表面。

让几座突出的建筑自然向上过渡为拉长的竖向光带，仿佛在极长曝光下被记录下来。这一效果应当由建筑本身自然生长而成，而非作为一个独立的图形层叠加上去。

在自然存在水面的位置，构筑建筑、太阳、光痕与周围景观的平静镜像反射。反射应比主画面略微软化、略带失真。

运用电影感的雾霭、真实的大气纵深、清晰的建筑质感、细腻的枝叶、透光的窗户以及轻微的运动模糊。

色彩

以低饱和度的蓝灰色天空与受目的地启发的温暖金、橙、橘、铜色高光形成反差。色调应精致而感性与高水准，避免霓虹感或过度饱和。

风格

照片级真实感建筑摄影 × 超现实双重曝光 × 未来感超长曝光摄影 × 竖向光束 × 电影感旅行艺术。

未来感元素应与真实建筑在物理上融为一体，在历史身份与现代能量之间营造出一种不可思议却可信的转化。

最终美学

梦幻、氛围、精致、电影感、细节丰富，并明确指向 [COUNTRY / CITY / LOCATION / SUBJECT]。

避免通用化的建筑、虚构的地标、随机的摩天大楼、过度的霓虹、强烈的故障效果、卡通化风格、人工反射、杂乱、拼贴效果、文字、标志、水印、边框以及扁平的数字插画。

格式

4:5 竖版，单一无缝构图，照片级真实感细节，戏剧化的纵深，受控的竖向运动模糊，电影感光效，高品质概念旅行艺术成品。

The image must use a strict 3:4 vertical composition divided horizontally into two equal regions with an exact 1:1 height ratio. Each region occupies exactly 50% of the total image height.

Use the original uploaded photo directly as the upper 50% of the composition.

Preserve the subject's exact identity, facial features, body structure, proportions, posture, perspective, clothing, materials, lighting, and original color atmosphere.

Do not regenerate, reshape, distort, stretch, beautify, or alter the subject.

Reconstruct the same subject and scene as a minimalist contemporary ink wash artwork.

First identify and preserve the most recognizable elements of the original image, including silhouette, outline, structure, perspective, movement, visual rhythm, spatial relationship, and overall atmosphere.

Do not directly copy photographic details. Do not create a realistic reproduction. Instead, translate the original scene into an artistic ink wash interpretation that preserves its recognizable essence and visual relationship with the upper photograph.

The lower artwork should feel summarized, refined, poetic, and intentionally incomplete rather than realistically detailed.

Use black, charcoal gray, soft gray, and diluted ink tones as the dominant palette.

Create clear tonal layering with varied ink density, pressure, rhythm, and transparency.

Extract only a few emotionally important colors from the original image and reinterpret them as small areas of artistic staining or pigment.

Maintain strong asymmetrical balance and a sophisticated editorial composition.

The edges of the ink artwork should gradually loosen, fragment, fade, scatter, and disappear into the paper, creating a natural sense of breathing space.

Typography must remain subtle, sparse, elegant, and secondary to the visual composition.

Contemporary Eastern aesthetics.

Premium art magazine presentation.

Exhibition photography quality.

Large-scale intentional negative space.

Seedance 2.5 Prompt
Create a 15-second Japanese anime action-comedy with synchronized sound. Use the selected output aspect ratio.

STORY
A charges a world-ending spell through her staff. B notices its ordinary electrical cable and unplugs it from the wall. Every magical effect instantly switches off. End on A's familiar silent, stunned face.

REFERENCES
A = black-haired heroine from @Image 1. Her voice comes only from @Audio 1.
B = white-haired heroine from @Image 2. B has no voice reference and is completely silent.
Preserve exact faces, hairstyles, costumes, accessories, proportions and original 2D art styles. Images define identity, not poses, backgrounds or sheet layouts.
Exactly ONE A and ONE B. Equal standing height, excluding ornaments. No mixed identities or clones.
The staff is an added handheld prop; costumes stay unchanged.
VISUAL STYLE AND LOCATION
The heroines remain hand-drawn 2D anime with clean linework and cel shading.
Photorealistic fictional Shibuya rooftop at dusk: concrete, one rear wall and distant buildings. Match lighting and shadows while preserving illustrated faces.
Sharp violet magic, luminous arcs and sparks. Keep character silhouettes clear.
A stays screen-left; B stays screen-right near the wall socket. Both stand on the same level, about two meters apart. Keep screen direction and one consistent location.
No pedestrians, enemies, moving traffic or building destruction.

STAFF, CABLE AND SOCKET — CONTINUITY PRIORITY
ONE straight staff with a dark shaft and a simple round metal head containing a violet core. Its physical shape never changes.
A holds it upright in her right hand, with the base resting on the roof. She keeps this position during charging and unplugging.
ONE continuous black power cable is permanently attached to the staff's base. It runs visibly along the floor, then up to ONE white wall outlet beside B at waist height.
The cable ends in ONE ordinary black plug with two flat parallel metal pins.
The plug is fully inserted at the opening. All props already exist.
Keep this route and attachment. No extra cables, plugs or outlets.
B grips the plastic plug body with her right hand and pulls it straight out of the socket. She never pulls the cable itself or touches the pins.
The cable remains attached to the staff after unplugging. B continues holding the disconnected plug.
The spell stays fully active until the pins visibly clear the outlet. Only then does it switch off.
The staff, cable, outlet, characters and city remain physically intact. Only magical light and energy disappear.
VOICE
Exactly ONE spoken sentence.
Between 0.3 and 1.8 seconds, A confidently says in Japanese, using @Audio 1: 「せかいよ、おわれ！」
Synchronize only A's lips to this line. Finish before 2.0 seconds.
The audio reference defines her voice, not the script. Never replay its recorded words.
B produces no speech or vocal reaction.
After 2.0 seconds, neither heroine produces dialogue, improvised words, gasps, grunts, screams, sighs, laughter, humming or audible breaths. No narration or inner monologue.
Physical effects and ambience continue.
0.0–3.5s — OVERWHELMING MAGIC
Begin with a stable, dramatic medium-wide two-shot.
A holds the upright staff and speaks the single line. B stands beside the wall, calmly watching.
The violet core ignites. A huge luminous sphere forms directly above the staff head, linked to it by a short energy column.
The sphere expands to approximately three meters across. Violet arcs circulate around it, sparks climb upward and a magical wind lifts the heroines' loose fabric and hair slightly.
Use powerful light and bass; both characters stay in place.
The spell is charging only. No projectile, beam or actual world destruction.
Keep A's speaking face readable. No obscuring smoke or white flash.
3.5–6.0s — THE ORDINARY POWER SOURCE
Cut to a clear view of the staff base, the black cable on the floor and its route toward B's wall outlet.
A's spell remains active at the same intensity.
B follows the cable with her eyes, then looks at the plug. Her lips stay closed. No conversation or invitation gesture.
Briefly frame the fully inserted plug and outlet as an ordinary household connection.
By 6.0 seconds, B's right hand has grasped the plastic plug body. It remains inserted. She has not disconnected it yet.
Do not move the staff or detach the cable from its base.
6.0–9.0s — UNPLUGGING ENDS EVERYTHING
Cut to a locked three-quarter view that includes B's hand and outlet clearly in the foreground, with A's staff and active magical sphere visible to the left.
Keep the extraction and magical shutdown in ONE continuous shot.
Around 8.0 seconds, B pulls the plug straight out once. Show a brief separation with both metal pins visibly outside the socket.
At that exact moment, the giant sphere, energy column, violet arcs, sparks and magical wind all switch off together.
The sphere vanishes instantly like a powered light. No fade, explosion or second spell.
The staff's core becomes dark while its metal head and shaft stay unchanged.
The scene returns to its original dusk lighting, not total darkness.
Stop the music and magical roar at disconnection. A small plastic click and a brief descending power-down sound, then quiet.
B keeps holding the unplugged black plug. Her mouth stays closed.
9.0–12.0s — THE AWKWARD REALIZATION
Return to the original medium two-shot.
A remains in her grand casting pose, holding the now-inert staff upright.
She looks up at the empty space where the sphere was, then down toward the staff and across to the disconnected plug in B's hand.
Her proud smile disappears.
B remains relaxed beside the outlet, holding the plug near her waist. No conversational gestures or vocals.
Let the exposed power connection explain the joke.
Clearly show the empty outlet and intact cable.

12.0–15.0s — THE FAMILIAR FACE
Cut to A's face.
Preserve her exact reference features. Eyes widen, pupils become slightly smaller, eyebrows rise and lips part once into a small stunned expression.
Hold the mouth still afterward. No repeated lip movements or vocal sound.
Use her familiar uncomprehending face, without crying, blush or an exaggerated scream.
Apply a short, controlled push-in. Hold the final full second.
End directly on A's silent face. No cut back, reconnection or extra gag.
SOUND
Opening: dramatic instrumental percussion, low strings, a deep magical charging hum and sharp energy crackles. No choir or vocal samples.
The ordinary plug click must be distinct.
At disconnection, abruptly remove the music, charging hum and energy sounds. Allow only the short power-down sound.
Afterward, faint rooftop wind and distant city ambience. No comedy sting or canned laughter.
EXCLUDE
Text, subtitles, logos, watermarks, HUD, clones, extra limbs or fingers, fused hands, redesigns, injury, electrocution, gore, camera rotation or extra characters.

CORE CONCEPT
Capture the chosen landmark as a spontaneous sketch made directly on location by a skilled travel artist. Preserve its recognizable silhouette, proportions, architecture, and defining features, but interpret them with quick, economical marks rather than fully rendering every detail.

COMPOSITION
Show ONE natural street-level viewpoint, choosing the most characteristic perspective for the landmark. Include only a small amount of surrounding architecture, greenery, street elements, and a few tiny gestural figures where appropriate.

Let the drawing naturally dissolve into untouched white paper around the edges. Keep the landmark as the clear focal point while allowing parts of the scene to remain unfinished.

SKETCH STYLE
Use loose observational urban-sketch techniques:
- light wandering graphite construction lines
- occasional confident dark ink accents
- quick transparent watercolor washes
- visible brushstrokes, blooms and pigment overlaps
- irregular, broken and doubled lines
- simplified architectural details
- areas where watercolor crosses or escapes the linework
- generous untouched paper

Concentrate detail around the landmark’s most recognizable architectural features and allow secondary areas to fade into suggestive marks.

COLOR
Use a small, restrained watercolor palette naturally derived from the real landmark and its surroundings. Keep the paper predominantly white and allow subtle variations, uneven washes, and accidental edges to remain visible.

FINAL AESTHETIC
Authentic travel sketchbook × European urban sketching × loose watercolor × graphite observation × handmade artistic spontaneity.

The image should feel like a beautiful 20–30 minute sketch made while sitting in front of the landmark — observant, imperfect, intimate, and alive.

Avoid photorealism, polished architectural rendering, overly precise linework, fully painted backgrounds, uniform detail, digital smoothness, heavy shading, excessive colors, decorative borders, text, logos, and watermarks.

FORMAT
4:5 vertical, single cohesive sketchbook page, natural street-level perspective, white paper, loose unfinished edges, expressive watercolor and graphite texture.

@Image 1 定义女主角的身份：深色短波浪卷发、四肢修长纤细的身材，以及造型：超大号驼色 V 领 T 恤、蓬松的驼色灯笼裤（带罗纹收口）、米白色运动鞋。将所有面板视为同一个人。不要使用其白色背景、面板布局或无头裁切。@Image 2 定义世界观与视觉风格：柔和绘画风格化的三维插画，高耸的积云、蓝天、漂浮堆叠的贫民窟塔楼并悬挂着缆线。不要将其静态姿势或取景用作首帧。始终保持这种绘画风格化的媒介。禁止写实皮肤。在允许自然表情变化、呼吸和头部活动的同时，保留面部特征与身材比例。设定：在两座漂浮塔楼之间、远高于云层的高空中，一根极细的线横跨其间。她似乎是唯一的人。那条线几乎不可见，因此她仿佛站立在空气之上。[0–3 秒] 广角建立镜头，摄影机从云层下缓缓升起。她在线的中段站立，双臂张开保持平衡，裤腿在风中摇摆。神情平静，目光专注望向远方。[3–6 秒] 侧面跟拍推车随她移动。她快速迈出三步，双手撑在线上，完成一个前软翻：双腿扫过，一只脚先落地，随后另一只脚落地，重心在线上恢复。在弧顶短暂变速为慢动作，然后恢复正常速度。[6–9 秒] 自上而下的鸟瞰视角，直直越过她的身体俯瞰远下方的云层。她发起一个脱手前空翻；灯笼裤在她双腿周围鼓胀张开。落地时她的身体晃动；一次短促的推拉变焦将下方的深渊拉伸，产生眩晕感。[9–12 秒] 极特写：她的运动鞋压在线上，略微形变。沿线条重新对焦：阳光短暂照亮，一条蛛丝般的闪光沿线滑过，然后消失，线再次隐形。她的手臂矫正平衡；她呼出一口气，稳住自己。[12–16 秒] 荷兰角 FPV 环绕镜头围绕她完整旋转 360°。她单脚完成一个受控的皮鲁埃特旋转，接入一个阿拉伯式伸展动作，双臂伸展，漂浮的塔楼在她身后滑过。她的表情从紧张转为自信的淡淡微笑。[16–20 秒] 极低角度的虫眼视角。她完成最后一个前团身翻，双脚干净地落在线上，膝盖缓冲，双臂大开。摄影机拉远并升起为广角镜头；她保持最终姿态，下巴抬起，望向远处的云。[9–12 秒] 物理：每一次跳跃都展现蹬离、手或脚与线的接触、以及平衡恢复。线在她重量下略微下沉并回弹。头发与衣物跟随她的动作和风。危险通过晃动和下方深渊来感受，但她永不坠落。[12–16 秒] 音频：高空的风声，衣物拍打 <whoosh>，落地时线轻微的 <creak>，闪光时一丝微弱的 <ting>。无音乐、无对白、无字幕、无文字。

@Image 1 定义女主角的身份：深色短波浪卷发、四肢修长纤细的身材，以及造型：超大号驼色 V 领 T 恤、蓬松的驼色灯笼裤（带罗纹收口）、米白色运动鞋。将所有面板视为同一个人。不要使用其白色背景、面板布局或无头裁切。@Image 2 定义世界观与视觉风格：柔和绘画风格化的三维插画，高耸的积云、蓝天、漂浮堆叠的贫民窟塔楼并悬挂着缆线。不要将其静态姿势或取景用作首帧。始终保持这种绘画风格化的媒介。禁止写实皮肤。在允许自然表情变化、呼吸和头部活动的同时，保留面部特征与身材比例。设定：在两座漂浮塔楼之间、远高于云层的高空中，一根极细的线横跨其间。她似乎是唯一的人。那条线几乎不可见，因此她仿佛站立在空气之上。[0–3 秒] 广角建立镜头，摄影机从云层下缓缓升起。她在线的中段站立，双臂张开保持平衡，裤腿在风中摇摆。神情平静，目光专注望向远方。[3–6 秒] 侧面跟拍推车随她移动。她快速迈出三步，双手撑在线上，完成一个前软翻：双腿扫过，一只脚先落地，随后另一只脚落地，重心在线上恢复。在弧顶短暂变速为慢动作，然后恢复正常速度。[6–9 秒] 自上而下的鸟瞰视角，直直越过她的身体俯瞰远下方的云层。她发起一个脱手前空翻；灯笼裤在她双腿周围鼓胀张开。落地时她的身体晃动；一次短促的推拉变焦将下方的深渊拉伸，产生眩晕感。[9–12 秒] 极特写：她的运动鞋压在线上，略微形变。沿线条重新对焦：阳光短暂照亮，一条蛛丝般的闪光沿线滑过，然后消失，线再次隐形。她的手臂矫正平衡；她呼出一口气，稳住自己。[12–16 秒] 荷兰角 FPV 环绕镜头围绕她完整旋转 360°。她单脚完成一个受控的皮鲁埃特旋转，接入一个阿拉伯式伸展动作，双臂伸展，漂浮的塔楼在她身后滑过。她的表情从紧张转为自信的淡淡微笑。[16–20 秒] 极低角度的虫眼视角。她完成最后一个前团身翻，双脚干净地落在线上，膝盖缓冲，双臂大开。摄影机拉远并升起为广角镜头；她保持最终姿态，下巴抬起，望向远处的云。[9–12 秒] 物理：每一次跳跃都展现蹬离、手或脚与线的接触、以及平衡恢复。线在她重量下略微下沉并回弹。头发与衣物跟随她的动作和风。危险通过晃动和下方深渊来感受，但她永不坠落。[12–16 秒] 音频：高空的风声，衣物拍打 <whoosh>，落地时线轻微的 <creak>，闪光时一丝微弱的 <ting>。无音乐、无对白、无字幕、无文字。

Premium Editorial Poster Instructions

Each uploaded photo must be made into a separate, independent, premium editorial poster, and multiple photos must not be combined. Use a strict 3:4 vertical canvas. Split the canvas horizontally in the exact center: the upper half and the lower half each occupy 50% of the height, are equally wide, and equally high, with no alteration of proportion.

The upper half uses the original photo directly and must not be regenerated. Preserve the identity of the main subject, the human body or architectural structure, proportions, perspective, spatial relationships, texture, natural light and shadow, color, and environment in their entirety. Only slight cropping and restrained premium color grading are permitted; re-drawing the main subject, fictional light, HDR, excessive saturation, plastic texture, and fictional content are prohibited. hibited. When needing to adapt to the frame, only environmental areas such as sky, water surface, ground, walls, plants, or background can be extended.

The lower half extracts and reconstructs the "narrative core" of the photo: it can be a single primary subject, or a group of related elements that together embody the photo's identity, scale, action, o story relationship. Maintain its realistic, recognizable appearance, proportion, internal structure, texture, and relative position. Do not remove important related elements, and do not directly us rectangular photo cutouts. The reconstructed subject typically occupies 55%-80% of the width of the lower area. It should naturally extend based on the photo's primary direction and retain plausible ground, water lines, shadows, or softly dissipated edges to integrate into the background, avoiding a sticker-like or floating appearance.

Incorporate a narrow, low-saturation geometric color field behind or through the center of the subject, serving as a "critical window" between reality and editorial abstraction. The color of the window must be extracted from the original photo, and its orientation (horizontal, vertical, or diagonal) chosen based on the overall narrative direction.

The subject must actively pass through the window: part of it is within the color field, and part enters the open negative space, naturally crossing the window's boundary to create occlusion, penetration, and spatial depth. The window is not a frame or a card; it must not fully enclose the subject. Only one primary window is allowed; multiple color blocks, thick borders, rounded corners, strong gradients, and drop shadows are prohibited.

Use a white, cool white, very light gray, or near-white background for the lower half, coordinated with the photo. Employ a restrained asymmetrical composition and abundant negative space to establish a three-tier hierarchy:

Reconstructed subject or narrative composition

Low-saturation geometric window

高级编辑海报制作指令

每张上传的照片必须制作成一张独立的、高级的编辑海报，所有图片不得合并。使用严格的 3:4 纵向画布。在正中央水平分割画布：上半部分和下半部分各占画布高度的 50%，宽度相同，高度相同，不得改变比例。

上半部分直接使用原始照片，不得重新生成。需完整保留主体的身份特征、人体或建筑结构、比例、透视、空间关系、纹理、自然光影、色彩以及环境。仅允许轻微裁剪和克制的高级调色；禁止重绘主体、虚构光线、HDR、过度饱和、塑料质感以及虚构内容。上方一张。需要在画面中进行适配时，仅可延伸天空、水面、地面、墙体、植物或背景等环境区域。

下半部分提取并重构照片的"叙事核心"：可以是一个主要主体，也可以是一组相关的元素，它们共同体现照片的身份、规模、动作或故事情节关系。需保持其真实、可辨识的外观、比例、内部结构、纹理以及相对位置。不得移除重要的相关元素，也不得直接使用矩形照片剪贴。重构主体一般占下半部分宽度的 55%–80%。它应根据照片的主要方向自然延伸，并保留合理的地面、水线、阴影或柔和消散的边缘，以融入背景，避免出现贴纸般或悬浮的外观。

在主体的中心后方或穿过主体中心处，嵌入一个窄幅、低饱和度的几何色块，作为现实与编辑抽象之间的"关键窗口"。窗口的颜色必须从原始照片中提取，其取向（水平、垂直或对角）应根据整体叙事方向进行选择。

主体必须主动穿过该窗口：其一部分位于色块内部，另一部分进入开放的负空间，自然跨越窗口边界，以形成遮挡、穿透和空间纵深。窗口不是画框，也不是卡片，不得完全包裹主体。仅允许出现一个主窗口；禁止使用多个色块、粗边框、圆角、强渐变以及投影效果。

下半部分采用白色、冷白色、极浅灰色或近白色背景，与照片协调。使用克制的非对称构图和大量负空间，以建立三层层次结构：

重构主体或叙事构图

低饱和度的几何窗口

将上传的照片转换为一幅高端旅行回忆剪贴簿海报。

Transform the uploaded photo into a premium travel-memory scrapbook poster.

Keep the original photo as the main visual reference and preserve the important subjects, objects, environment, composition, colors, and recognizable details accurately. Do not change the identity or structure of the main subject.

Create a vertical 3:4 editorial scrapbook layout divided horizontally into two equal sections:

TOP 50%:
Place the original photograph prominently, enhanced with warm, natural, slightly cinematic color grading. Keep it realistic, detailed, and photographic. Do not over-edit or make it look artificial.

BOTTOM 50%:
Create a beautiful hand-drawn illustrated journal page inspired directly by the photograph. Extract 6–9 of the most recognizable visual elements from the original image and turn each into a small individual colored-pencil / ink / watercolor-style sketch arranged in a clean 3×3 scrapbook grid.

Use:
- textured warm ivory/off-white paper background
- subtle paper grain
- hand-drawn pencil and ink outlines
- loose colored-pencil and watercolor shading
- slightly imperfect handmade strokes
- soft muted but cheerful colors
- tiny doodles such as stars, hearts, leaves, sparkles, waves and arrows
- thin, delicate hand-drawn grid dividers
- cozy travel-journal aesthetic
- sophisticated editorial composition
- authentic handmade imperfections

Add a handwritten title at the top of the illustrated section, customized to the photo's theme, such as “[LOCATION] Memories”, “[THEME] Moments”, “Sweet Moments”, “Blue Sky Memories”, etc.

Under each illustrated element, add a short handwritten label describing it, for example:
“street lamp”, “soft clouds”, “colorful lights”, “tea”, “old walls”, “sweet treat”, “green moments”, etc.

At the very bottom, add a small handwritten sentimental caption related to the photo, such as:
“a perfect day to remember ♡”
or
“same place, different feelings ♡”

The final result should feel like a luxury travel scrapbook / visual diary page created by hand, combining a real photograph with charming illustrated memories.

IMPORTANT:
- One original photo + one illustrated memory section
- Clean 50/50 horizontal division
- Vertical 3:4 composition
- Preserve the original photo realistically
- Illustrations must clearly originate from objects in the uploaded photo
- No photorealistic illustrations
- No 3D rendering
- No excessive graphic-design effects
- No borders around individual illustrations
- No random objects unrelated to the photo
- Keep typography minimal, elegant, and handwritten
- Make the entire page cohesive, warm, nostalgic, artistic, and premium

将上传的照片转换为一幅高端旅行回忆剪贴簿海报。

以原始照片作为主要视觉参考，准确保留重要的主体、物体、环境、构图、色彩以及可辨识的细节。不要改变主体的身份或结构。

创建一个竖向 3:4 的编辑式剪贴簿布局，水平分为两个相等的部分：

顶部 50%：
将原始照片显著呈现，并加以温暖、自然、略带电影感的色彩调色。保持真实、细腻、摄影化的质感。不要过度编辑或让其显得不自然。

底部 50%：
直接借鉴照片，创建一个精美的手绘插画日记页。从原图中提取 6–9 个最具辨识度的视觉元素，并将每一个转化为小幅的彩色铅笔 / 墨水 / 水彩风格的素描，按整洁的 3×3 剪贴簿网格排列。

使用：
- 带有肌理的温暖象牙色 / 米白色纸张背景
- 细微的纸张颗粒感
- 手绘铅笔和墨线轮廓
- 宽松的彩色铅笔和水彩晕染
- 略带不完美的手绘笔触
- 柔和低调但明快的色彩
- 小巧的涂鸦，如星星、爱心、树叶、闪光、波浪和箭头
- 纤细精致的手绘网格分隔线
- 温馨的旅行日记美学
- 精致的编辑式构图
- 真实自然的手作不完美感

在插画部分的顶部添加手写标题，根据照片的主题定制，例如 “[地点] Memories”、“[主题] Moments”、“Sweet Moments”、“Blue Sky Memories”等。

在每个插画元素下方添加简短的手写标签进行描述，例如：
“street lamp”、“soft clouds”、“colorful lights”、“tea”、“old walls”、“sweet treat”、“green moments”等。

在最底部添加与照片相关的小型手写感伤题注，例如：
“a perfect day to remember ♡”
或
“same place, different feelings ♡”

最终成品应感觉像一本由手工创作的高端旅行剪贴簿 / 视觉日记页面，将真实照片与迷人的插画回忆相结合。

重要提示：
- 一张原始照片 + 一个插画回忆部分
- 整洁的 50/50 水平分割

Create a premium vintage Indian postage-stamp travel poster for [COUNTRY / CITY / LOCATION / SUBJECT].

TEXT-TO-IMAGE ONLY — generate the entire artwork creatively from [COUNTRY / CITY / LOCATION / SUBJECT] alone. No reference image required.

CORE CONCEPT
Transform the destination into a collectible vintage postage stamp, presenting its most iconic architecture, culture, landscape, and local character as a finely engraved travel illustration.

STAMP DESIGN
Create ONE centered postage stamp with authentic perforated edges and a subtle cream paper texture. Automatically select the most recognizable landmark or combination of visual elements that represents the destination.

Use detailed engraved linework, delicate crosshatching, vintage print texture, and slightly imperfect ink registration for an authentic old-world postal aesthetic.

INDIAN IDENTITY
Give the stamp a refined Indian postal character with:
- “भारत INDIA” as the header
- ₹100 denomination
- destination name in elegant Latin lettering
- the destination name again in its appropriate regional script

Adapt the regional script and cultural details accurately to the chosen location.

COLOR & COMPOSITION
Use a restrained destination-inspired palette with 3–5 complementary vintage colors. Keep the cream paper visible around the artwork and maintain strong visual hierarchy.

Include only meaningful local details — architecture, landscape, traditional motifs, vegetation, transportation, or cultural elements that genuinely belong to the destination.

STYLE
Vintage Indian postage stamp × engraved illustration × heritage printmaking × collectible travel ephemera.

The result should feel authentic, minimal, timeless, sophisticated, and museum-worthy rather than like a modern digital poster.

Avoid photorealism, glossy rendering, excessive colors, generic landmarks, invented cultural details, clutter, modern graphic effects, multiple separate stamps, logos, watermarks, and excessive text.

FORMAT
One stamp per image, vertical composition, perforated border, cream paper texture, highly detailed engraving, elegant typography, premium collectible finish.

将目的地转化为一张可收藏的复古邮票,以精细的版画旅行插画呈现其最具代表性的建筑、文化、风景与本土特色。

邮票设计
创作 ONE(一枚)居中的邮票,带有真实的齿孔边缘与淡淡的米色纸张纹理。自动选取最能代表该目的地的标志性景观或视觉元素组合。

使用细腻的雕版线条、精细的交叉影线、复古印刷质感,并略微保留套印不准的痕迹,以呈现真实的老派邮政美学。

印度风格特征
赋予邮票精致的印度邮政气质,包含:
- 顶部标题 “भारत INDIA”
- 面值 ₹100
- 优雅的拉丁字母书写的目的地名称
- 再以该地区相应的本土文字书写一遍目的地名称

根据所选地点准确适配本土文字与文化细节。

色彩与构图
采用克制的、源自目的地的配色方案,使用 3–5 种互补的复古色调。保留米色纸张在画面周围的留白,并保持强烈的视觉层次。

仅纳入真正属于该目的地的本地细节——建筑、风景、传统纹样、植物、交通工具或文化元素。

风格
复古印度邮票 × 雕版插画 × 传统版画工艺 × 可收藏旅行雅玩。

成品应呈现真实、极简、永恒、精致、可入藏的质感,而非现代数字海报。

避免照片级写实、光泽化渲染、过多色彩、泛化地标、虚构的文化细节、杂乱构图、现代图形特效、多枚独立邮票、标志、水印及过多文字。

格式
每张图像一枚邮票,纵向构图,带齿孔边框,米色纸张质感,高度精细的雕版细节,优雅的字体排印,顶级收藏级成品。

Add colorful trees, flowers, pedestrians, bicycles, vintage cars, street signs and subtle city-life details around the architecture.

Behind the landmark, include a delicate illustrated city map in pale pastel lines, architectural measurement marks, tiny street names and faint blueprint details. Add a small architectural detail sketch on one side, as if taken from an old design archive.

[CITY NAME]
[LANDMARK NAME]
small location coordinates beneath.

At the bottom, include elegant archival-style information such as EST. [YEAR] · ARCHITECTURAL STYLE · CITY · COUNTRY.

The overall image should feel like a luxury collectible travel poster, combining colored-pencil texture, watercolor washes, fine ink drawing, subtle wax-crayon grain and vintage print imperfections. [STYLE + CAMERA + ATMOSPHERE]

Cinematic cutscene of a hand-painted 2D point-and-click adventure game from the nineties, remade today. Fluid full-frame-rate cut-out animation of stick-figure characters over gouache painted backgrounds, flat side-on staging, locked game camera with a gentle parallax drift. Dry deadpan comedy with snappy timing. Seven shots joined by hard cuts.

[IMAGE REFERENCES]

Lewis [sheet_1], Mrs. Abernathy [sheet_2] and the fat orange tabby cat stay identical in every shot.

The stick figures have mouthless black faces: they talk with head nods, eye shapes and hand gestures. The cat talks with its mouth.

[AUDIO]

Language: American English.

Lewis: tired, dry, flat baritone.
Mrs. Abernathy: warm, sweet elderly voice.
Cat: very deep, gravelly bass.

Ambience of birds, light breeze and rustling leaves.
No background music.
No subtitles.

[TIMELINE]

0-4s: [Wide Shot] [scene_1]

Lewis taps his pencil on the notepad, lets out a sigh and says, flat:

{A cat got lost. A cat got found. Front page stuff.}

The huge cat sags heavier in her arms while she beams.

4-9s: [Close-Up] Hard cut to [scene_2]

She squeezes the cat, eyes glossy:

{He was gone for eleven whole minutes.}

The cat slowly turns its head to the viewer and says:

{Ask me about them, Lewis.}

9-13s: [Medium Shot] Hard cut to [scene_3]

Lewis stands frozen, eyes wide; the pencil hits the sidewalk <pencil clatter> and rolls.

He says:

{Ma'am... did your cat just talk?}

She answers with a calm little nod:

{He only talks to the press.}

13-18s: [Full Shot, low angle] Hard cut to [scene_4]

The cat rises, weightless, turning slowly, up past the maple crown into the lilac sky while leaves drift upward.

She waves it goodbye:

{He does that.}

Lewis watches it go, eyes half-lidded:

{I should've gone to law school.}

18-22s: [Wide Shot] Hard cut to [scene_5]

Purple clouds swirl, the colossal cat leans in over the rooftops, tiny Lewis's hair blows back.

Its mouth opens and the voice booms with a long echo:

{Wake up, Lewis.}

22-26s: [Medium Shot] Hard cut to [scene_6]

Sudden quiet, <alarm clock ticking>.

One still beat, then Lewis bolts upright in bed, eyes snapping wide open, the quilt sliding off his chest.

He stares ahead and mutters:

{...Eleven minutes.}

26-30s: [Wide Shot] Hard cut to [ingame_scene]

Lewis walks in from the left at an even pace and stops in front of the standing mirror, in profile facing right, his reflection appearing in the glass.

The red radio murmurs, tinny:

{...and in local news, a cat...}

He holds perfectly still for the final second.

[STYLE & QUALITY BOOSTERS]

Hand-painted gouache backgrounds with paper grain, clean ink outlines, smooth fluid 2D animation, stable characters and wardrobe in every shot, coherent motion, crisp hard cuts, the painted backgrounds stay fixed inside each shot.

[风格 + 镜头 + 氛围]

一段电影感过场动画,源自一款九十年代的2D点击冒险游戏,以当代手法重制。手绘剪纸风格动画,帧率流畅饱满,火柴人角色置于水粉画背景之上,平面侧向舞台调度,镜头锁定为游戏摄像机,带有轻微视差漂移。冷面干瘪喜剧,节奏干脆利落。七个镜头之间以硬切衔接。

[图像参考]

Lewis[sheet_1]、Mrs. Abernathy[sheet_2]和那只胖胖的橘色虎斑猫在每个镜头中保持完全一致。

火柴人为无嘴黑色面孔:他们通过点头、眼神变化和手势来表达对话。猫则用嘴说话。

[音频]

语言:美式英语。

Lewis:疲倦、干涩、平淡的低音男声。
Mrs. Abernathy:温暖、甜美的老年女声。
猫:非常低沉、沙哑的低音。

环境声:鸟鸣、轻风、树叶沙沙作响。
无背景音乐。
无字幕。

[时间线]

0-4s:[远景][scene_1]

Lewis用铅笔轻敲记事本,叹一口气,平淡地说:

{一只猫走丢了。一只猫找到了。头版大新闻。}

巨大的猫在她怀里愈发沉重地垂下,而她笑开了花。

4-9s:[特写] 硬切至 [scene_2]

她紧紧搂住猫,眼眶湿润:

{他整整失踪了十一分钟。}

猫缓缓把头转向镜头,说道:

{问问我是怎么回事吧,Lewis。}

9-13s:[中景] 硬切至 [scene_3]

Lewis僵在原地,瞪大眼睛;铅笔落到人行道上 <铅笔落地声> 并滚开。

他说:

{女士……您的猫刚才开口说话了?}

她平静地轻轻点头,答道:

{他只跟新闻界说话。}

13-18s:[全景,低角度] 硬切至 [scene_4]

猫轻盈地升起,缓缓旋转着越过枫树树冠,升入淡紫色的天空,叶子向上飘起。

她向它挥手道别:

{他就是这样的。}

Lewis半垂着眼看着它离去:

{我当初真该去读法学院。}

18-22s:[远景] 硬切至 [scene_5]

紫色云层翻涌,巨猫越过屋顶俯身探来,渺小的Lewis头发被吹起。

它张开嘴,声音轰然作响,伴着悠长的回响:

{Lewis,醒醒。}

22-26s:[中景] 硬切至 [scene_6]

突然安静下来,<闹钟滴答声>。

静止一拍,然后Lewis猛地从床上坐起,眼睛骤然睁大,被子从胸口滑落。

他凝视前方,低语:

{……十一分钟。}

26-30s:[远景] 硬切至 [ingame_scene]

Lewis以均匀的步伐从左侧走入,在立式穿衣镜前停下,呈右侧向的侧面姿态,玻璃中映出他的倒影。

红色收音机喃喃作响,声音发尖:

{……本地新闻,一只猫……}

最后一秒他纹丝不动。

[风格与质量增强器]

手绘水粉画背景,带纸面纹理,干净的墨线轮廓,流畅顺滑的2D动画,每个镜头中角色与服饰保持稳定,动作连贯一致,硬切清晰利落,每个镜头内的手绘背景保持固定不变。

0-4s:[远景][scene_1]

Lewis用铅笔轻敲记事本,叹一口气,平淡地说:

巨大的猫在她怀里愈发沉重地垂下,而她笑开了花。

4-9s:[特写] 硬切至 [scene_2]

她紧紧搂住猫,眼眶湿润:

{他整整失踪了十一分钟。}

猫缓缓把头转向镜头,说道:

{问问我是怎么回事吧,Lewis。}

9-13s:[中景] 硬切至 [scene_3]

Lewis僵在原地,瞪大眼睛;铅笔落到人行道上 <铅笔落地声> 并滚开。

他说:

{女士……您的猫刚才开口说话了?}

她平静地轻轻点头,答道:

{他只跟新闻界说话。}

13-18s:[全景,低角度] 硬切至 [scene_4]

猫轻盈地升起,缓缓旋转着越过枫树树冠,升入淡紫色的天空,叶子向上飘起。

她向它挥手道别:

{他就是这样的。}

Lewis半垂着眼看着它离去:

{我当初真该去读法学院。}

18-22s:[远景] 硬切至 [scene_5]

紫色云层翻涌,巨猫越过屋顶俯身探来,渺小的Lewis头发被吹起。

它张开嘴,声音轰然作响,伴着悠长的回响:

{Lewis,醒醒。}

22-26s:[中景] 硬切至 [scene_6]

突然安静下来,<闹钟滴答声>。

静止一拍,然后Lewis猛地从床上坐起,眼睛骤然睁大,被子从胸口滑落。

他凝视前方,低语:

{……十一分钟。}

Here are some of the frames I used, including the last one, which is actually the very first frame of my video game. I’ll tell you more about it tomorrow. I’m so excited!

But first, the Seedance prompt, of course!

[STYLE + CAMERA + ATMOSPHERE]

Cinematic cutscene of a hand-painted 2D point-and-click adventure game from the nineties, remade today. Fluid full-frame-rate cut-out animation of stick-figure characters over gouache painted backgrounds, flat side-on staging, locked game camera with a gentle parallax drift. Dry deadpan comedy with snappy timing. Seven shots joined by hard cuts.

[IMAGE REFERENCES]

Lewis [sheet_1], Mrs. Abernathy [sheet_2] and the fat orange tabby cat stay identical in every shot.

The stick figures have mouthless black faces: they talk with head nods, eye shapes and hand gestures. The cat talks with its mouth.

[AUDIO]

Language: American English.

Lewis: tired, dry, flat baritone.
Mrs. Abernathy: warm, sweet elderly voice.
Cat: very deep, gravelly bass.

Ambience of birds, light breeze and rustling leaves.
No background music.
No subtitles.

[TIMELINE]

0-4s: [Wide Shot] [scene_1]

Lewis taps his pencil on the notepad, lets out a sigh and says, flat:

{A cat got lost. A cat got found. Front page stuff.}

The huge cat sags heavier in her arms while she beams.

4-9s: [Close-Up] Hard cut to [scene_2]

She squeezes the cat, eyes glossy:

{He was gone for eleven whole minutes.}

The cat slowly turns its head to the viewer and says:

{Ask me about them, Lewis.}

9-13s: [Medium Shot] Hard cut to [scene_3]

Lewis stands frozen, eyes wide; the pencil hits the sidewalk <pencil clatter> and rolls.

He says:

{Ma'am... did your cat just talk?}

She answers with a calm little nod:

{He only talks to the press.}

13-18s: [Full Shot, low angle] Hard cut to [scene_4]

The cat rises, weightless, turning slowly, up past the maple crown into the lilac sky while leaves drift upward.

She waves it goodbye:

{He does that.}

Lewis watches it go, eyes half-lidded:

{I should've gone to law school.}

18-22s: [Wide Shot] Hard cut to [scene_5]

Purple clouds swirl, the colossal cat leans in over the rooftops, tiny Lewis's hair blows back.

Its mouth opens and the voice booms with a long echo:

{Wake up, Lewis.}

22-26s: [Medium Shot] Hard cut to [scene_6]

Sudden quiet, <alarm clock ticking>.

One still beat, then Lewis bolts upright in bed, eyes snapping wide open, the quilt sliding off his chest.

He stares ahead and mutters:

{...Eleven minutes.}

26-30s: [Wide Shot] Hard cut to [ingame_scene]

Lewis walks in from the left at an even pace and stops in front of the standing mirror, in profile facing right, his reflection appearing in the glass.

The red radio murmurs, tinny:

{...and in local news, a cat...}

He holds perfectly still for the final second.

[STYLE & QUALITY BOOSTERS]

Hand-painted gouache backgrounds with paper grain, clean ink outlines, smooth fluid 2D animation, stable characters and wardrobe in every shot, coherent motion, crisp hard cuts, the painted backgrounds stay fixed inside each shot.

创建一张照片级真实感的电影摄影参考海报，包含恰好 12 个面板，分为两列等宽、六…

Create a photorealistic cinematography reference poster containing exactly 12 panels in two equal columns and six rows. Each panel must demonstrate a distinct camera shot through an actual change in camera position or framing.

Main subject: A young adult man with short styled dark-brown hair, light stubble and a slim build. He wears a textured taupe-brown coat with dark buttons over a plain white crew-neck shirt, slim black trousers and white sneakers. Preserve his facial identity, hairstyle, clothing and proportions across every panel where he appears.

Location: A dim filmmaking studio with dark wooden furniture, muted grey walls, black ceiling beams, cream acoustic panels, a worktable, editing monitors, lighting stands, shelving and a leafy plant. Maintain consistent room details across viewpoints.

PANEL ORDER — LEFT TO RIGHT, TOP TO BOTTOM

Row 1
WIDE: Eye-level environmental shot. The man stands near the center, relatively small within the frame, surrounded by the studio and furniture.
LOW: Dramatic low-angle shot looking upward from below his waist. His upper body rises against the ceiling beams, with believable perspective.

Row 2
LONG: Full-length portrait showing his entire body from head to shoes, with a little space above and below. Studio equipment remains visible around him.
HIGH: Camera positioned above the man, looking steeply downward as he looks up. Show the floor and nearby table to establish the elevated viewpoint.

Row 3
MEDIUM: Eye-level waist-up portrait. His hands rest loosely together, expression relaxed, background softly blurred.
DUTCH: Medium-long shot with the camera rolled approximately 25 degrees. The room’s vertical lines visibly tilt while the man stands naturally upright within the room.

Row 4
COWBOY: Frame the man from mid-thigh to just above his head. He looks down with both hands in his coat pockets.
OVER THE SHOULDER: Look past the softly blurred head and shoulder of the brown-coated man in the right foreground toward a second young adult man wearing a black T-shirt and backward black cap. Keep the second man’s face sharp.

Row 5
TIGHT, with smaller subtitle CLOSE UP: Close portrait of the main subject’s face, from the top of his hair to just below his chin. Capture natural skin texture and a subtle, thoughtful expression.
POV, with smaller subtitle POINT OF VIEW: First-person view from the main subject’s seated position, looking down at his hands using a laptop on a dark table. Taupe coat cuffs visible. The screen shows a plausible grid of small video thumbnails.

Row 6
DETAIL, with smaller subtitle EXTREME CLOSE UP: Extreme close-up of the main subject’s eye, eyebrow and bridge of the nose. Render realistic eyelashes, pores and a small natural catchlight.
CUTAWAY: An insert shot of a professional cinema camera on a support rig in the same studio, with shelving and a small potted plant behind it. No person visible.

PHOTOGRAPHIC TREATMENT

Real live-action film-still appearance. Soft directional lighting, restrained warm skin tones, charcoal shadows, muted brown and grey colors, subtle grain and natural contrast. Use deeper focus for environmental views and shallow depth of field for portraits and detail shots. Preserve realistic anatomy, optical perspective and consistent facial features.

LAYOUT & TYPOGRAPHY

Tall 3:5 poster composition, edge-to-edge imagery, uniform panel dimensions, clean aligned divisions and no large gutters. Place each shot label near the lower-left corner of its panel in white uppercase sans-serif lettering with generous letter spacing. Use smaller, clearly readable subtitles beneath TIGHT, POV and DETAIL. Split OVER THE SHOULDER into two lines to fit neatly. Keep all text inside its own panel and away from important facial details.

Render only the specified shot labels. No additional headline, explanatory paragraphs, logos or watermarks.

Avoid: Missing or repeated panels, incorrect shot labels, inconsistent faces or outfits, identical framing across panels, malformed hands, distorted equipment, artificial skin, illustration, excessive HDR and unreadable typography.

创建一张照片级真实感的电影摄影参考海报，包含恰好 12 个面板，分为两列等宽、六行排列。每一个面板都必须通过实际改变机位或取景来展现一种不同的镜头。

主体人物：一名年轻成年男性，留着打理过的深棕色短发、淡淡的胡茬、身材偏瘦。他身穿质感明显的灰褐色（灰褐色）大衣，大衣配有深色纽扣，内搭纯白色圆领衬衫，下身穿修身黑色长裤和白色运动鞋。在他出现的每一个面板中，都要保持其面部特征、发型、服饰和身材比例一致。

场景：一间灯光昏暗的电影制作工作室，室内有深色木质家具、柔和的灰色墙壁、黑色天花横梁、米色声学板、一张工作台、剪辑监视器、灯具支架、置物架以及一株绿叶植物。不同视角下要保持房间细节一致。

面板顺序——从左到右、从上到下

第一行
WIDE（远景）：平视的环境镜头。男子站在画面中央偏后的位置，在画面中身形相对较小，被工作室和家具环绕。
LOW（低角度）：从他腰部以下向上仰拍的戏剧性低角度镜头。他的上半身映衬着天花横梁，呈现出可信的透视关系。

第二行
LONG（全景）：全身肖像，显示他从头到鞋的完整身体，上下留有少量空间。他周围依然可见工作室设备。
HIGH（俯角）：相机位于男子上方，在他向上看的时候大幅俯拍。需展示地板和附近的桌子，以确立升高的视角。

第三行
MEDIUM（中景）：平视的腰部以上肖像。他的双手自然地搭在一起，神情放松，背景柔和虚化。
DUTCH（荷兰角）：中等偏长的镜头，相机横滚约 25 度。房间的垂直线明显倾斜，但男子在房间中自然直立。

第四行
COWBOY（牛仔景）：从男子大腿中部到头顶略上一点进行构图。他低着头，双手插在大衣口袋里。
OVER THE SHOULDER（过肩镜头）：越过右前景中穿着棕色大衣、头部和肩部柔和虚化的男子，望向第二位戴黑色 T 恤、反戴黑色棒球帽的年轻成年男性。需保持第二位男子的面部清晰。

第五行
TIGHT（紧凑景），下排附较小副标题 CLOSE UP（特写）：主体的近距离肖像，从头顶发际到下巴略下方。需捕捉自然的皮肤质感和微妙、若有所思的表情。
POV（主观视角），下排附较小副标题 POINT OF VIEW（第一人称视角）：从其坐姿出发向下看，看到他在一张深色桌子上使用笔记本电脑的双手。可见灰褐色大衣袖口。屏幕上显示一个合理的小视频缩略图网格。

第六行
DETAIL（细节景），下排附较小副标题 EXTREME CLOSE UP（大特写）：主体眼睛、眉毛和鼻梁的大特写。需呈现真实的睫毛、毛孔和一处自然的微小高光。
CUTAWAY（插播镜头 / 空镜）：在同一工作室中，一台架设在支撑装置上的专业电影摄影机的插入镜头，其后方为置物架和一盆小型盆栽。画面中不出现人物。

摄影处理

呈现真实实拍剧照的外观。柔和的方向性光线、克制的暖色肤色调、木炭般的阴影、柔和的棕色与灰色、轻微的颗粒感和自然的对比度。环境视角使用较深的景深，人像和细节镜头使用浅景深。保持真实的解剖结构、光学透视和一致的面部特征。

布局与排版

高长比 3:5 的海报构图，画面延伸到边缘，面板尺寸统一，分割线整齐对齐，不留大间隔。每个镜头的标签置于其面板左下角附近，使用白色大写无衬线字体，字距宽松。TIGHT、POV 和 DETAIL 下方使用更小、清晰可读的副标题。OVER THE SHOULDER 拆为两行以整齐排布。所有文字需留在所属面板内，并避开重要的面部细节。

仅渲染指定的镜头标签。不要附加主标题、说明性段落、标志或水印。

需避免：缺失或重复的面板、错误的镜头标签、面部或服饰不一致、各面板取景相同、手部畸形、设备变形、人工变异般的皮肤、插画风格、过度的 HDR 以及无法辨认的排版。

Create ONE extraordinary ultra-photorealistic avant-garde fashion editorial photograph inspired by surreal theatrical couture and handcrafted fantasy studio photography.

SUBJECT:
A striking adult female fashion model photographed as a real human being. Elegant elongated proportions, sophisticated editorial presence, unusual but believable beauty, natural facial anatomy, realistic skin texture, visible pores, subtle imperfections, individual hair strands and authentic human detail. Her expression is calm, slightly strange, mysterious and fashion-forward rather than smiling.

CONCEPT:
Build the entire photograph around [THEME].

Transform the theme into a complete couture universe rather than simply placing decorative objects around the model. The clothing, hairstyle, makeup, footwear, pose, oversized prop, furniture and studio environment should all share the same visual language.

Create one unforgettable oversized practical centerpiece related to [THEME], approximately comparable in scale to the model. It must appear physically constructed for a real fashion shoot — fabric, painted wood, papier-mâché, rope, satin, leather, plaster or other believable handcrafted materials — with seams, stitching, folds, slight wear and tactile surface detail.

FASHION:
Design an original couture outfit with exaggerated sculptural proportions and immaculate tailoring. Use architectural shoulders, unusual silhouettes, corsetry, puffed or balloon forms, oversized bows, gathered fabric, dramatic hosiery and custom sculptural footwear where appropriate.

The garment must feel like a one-off creation made by an experimental couture atelier, not cosplay, Halloween clothing or a generic fantasy costume.

The styling should be eccentric and surreal but still sophisticated enough for a major high-fashion editorial.

HAIR & MAKEUP:
Create highly art-directed editorial hair that complements the concept: geometric shapes, sculptural forms, short graphic cuts, exaggerated bows or controlled theatrical styling.

Use conceptual runway makeup with carefully placed graphic details around the eyes and cheeks while retaining realistic skin. Makeup should feel professionally applied to a real model, never painted CGI skin.

COMPOSITION:
Full-body vertical fashion portrait.
The entire outfit and footwear are visible.
Model positioned in an unusual editorial pose — seated, leaning, balancing, extending one leg, interacting naturally with the oversized prop or suspended installation.

Use intentional negative space and strong graphic geometry.

The giant prop should create a bold silhouette around or behind the model without hiding her face.

SET DESIGN:
Photograph everything inside a real constructed studio set.

Use a seamless or lightly textured hand-painted backdrop in a sophisticated muted color palette. Add only a few carefully selected practical objects that reinforce the theme.

The environment should feel like an expensive physical fashion set built by set designers, not a digitally generated fantasy world.

Allow subtle imperfections: slightly worn painted wood, fabric wrinkles, visible stitching, handmade edges, aged surfaces and realistic contact shadows.

COLOR:
Use an art-directed limited palette of approximately 3–4 colors.

Combine muted vintage tones with one stronger accent color. Avoid random rainbow colors, oversaturation and modern neon aesthetics.

LIGHTING:
Large diffused studio key light from approximately 45 degrees, soft directional fill, subtle falloff toward the background and delicate separation around the model.

Realistic shadows underneath shoes, furniture and props.
No excessive rim lighting.
No glowing fantasy illumination.

The lighting should resemble an expensive medium-format editorial photographed inside a physical studio.

CAMERA:
Full-frame / medium-format fashion photography aesthetic,
approximately 50–85mm perspective,
camera around waist-to-chest height,
minimal perspective distortion,
sharp focus on model and principal prop,
fine textile and skin detail,
subtle optical softness,
natural depth,
high dynamic range.

IMAGE CHARACTER:
Surreal.
Whimsical.
Slightly uncanny.
Theatrical.
Retro-European fashion editorial.
Handcrafted.
Playful but sophisticated.
Museum-worthy couture photography.

The viewer should initially wonder whether this was an elaborate real-world fashion set rather than an AI-generated image.

REALISM PRIORITY:
100% photographic appearance.
Real adult human anatomy.
Real skin.
Natural hands and fingers.
Correct limbs.
Physically plausible interaction between body, clothing, furniture and props.
Authentic fabric tension and gravity.
Realistic stitching and material thickness.
Real contact shadows.
Believable weight and scale.

Preserve tiny imperfections that make physical photography convincing.

Avoid glossy CGI rendering, plastic skin, doll-like facial texture, generic AI beauty, excessive facial symmetry, fake depth of field, floating objects, malformed hands, extra fingers, duplicated limbs, impossible joints, melted fabrics, random accessories, meaningless decorations, cheap costume appearance, excessive background clutter, text, logos or watermark.

An original surreal couture campaign image that feels photographed for an experimental international fashion magazine — strange enough to stop scrolling immediately, yet polished, tactile and believable enough to look like an expensive real-world editorial production.

一位引人注目的成年女性时装模特，以真实人类的方式拍摄。优雅修长的身材比例，成熟的编辑级气场，不寻常但可信的美貌，自然的面部解剖结构，真实的皮肤质感，可见毛孔，微妙的瑕疵，丝丝分明的发丝与真实的人类细节。她的表情冷静、略带怪异、神秘且前卫，而非微笑。

围绕 [THEME] 构建整张照片。

这件服装必须让人感觉像是由实验性高级定制工坊制作的孤品，而非角色扮演服装、万圣节服饰或泛化的奇幻戏服。

创作高度艺术指导的编辑级发型，与概念相辅相成：几何造型、雕塑感形态、短款图形化修剪、夸张蝴蝶结或受控的戏剧性造型。

使用概念性的秀场妆容，在眼周与颧骨周围精心放置图形化细节，同时保留真实感的皮肤。妆容应让人感觉是专业地为真实模特上妆，而非 CGI 绘制的皮肤。

全身竖版时尚肖像。
整套服装与鞋履全部可见。
模特以不寻常的编辑姿势定位——坐着、倚靠、平衡、伸展一条腿、或自然地与超大道具或悬挂装置互动。

运用有意识的留白与强烈的图形几何感。

巨型道具应在模特周围或身后形成大胆的轮廓，但不遮挡她的面部。

场景设计：
将所有内容拍摄于一个真实搭建的工作室布景内。

使用无缝或轻微纹理的手绘背景幕布，色调采用精致的低饱和度调色板。仅添加少量精心挑选的、能够强化主题的实用物件。

环境应让人感觉是由布景师搭建的昂贵实体时装布景，而非数字生成的奇幻世界。

光线：
大型柔和的摄影棚主光，约 45° 角投射，柔和的方向性补光，向背景的微妙衰减，以及围绕模特的细腻分离光。

鞋子、家具与背景画布下方应有真实的阴影。

相机高度约在腰至胸部之间，
极小的透视畸变，
对模特与主要道具的锐利对焦，
细腻的织物与皮肤质感，
微妙的光学柔度，
自然的景深，
高动态范围。

超现实。
异想天开。
略带诡异。
戏剧性。
复古欧式时尚编辑风格。
手工打造。
俏皮但精致。
博物馆级的高级定制摄影。
